component.name: Tech2 Card Writer
component.summary: Write Saab and GM Tech 2 card images from Linux

description.p: Tech2 Card Writer is a small Linux front-end for the freeware Windows Tech2 Card Writer by AlexRE. It keeps a private Wine runtime, maps your USB-to-serial adapter to COM1, validates the card image, and opens the writer with a clear checklist.
It writes Tech 2 PCMCIA card images only. It does not program ECUs and is not a replacement for TIS2000 or SPS.

screenshot.caption: The main window with a detected serial port and a validated Saab 148.000 image
